title: integrity-floor contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-350). The SHAPE of the merge-floor decision `faff merge-gate` routes its merge through. `verdict` is merge-ok only when `violations` (the blockers) is empty. There is NO safe coerce to pass — an out-of-enum input fail-louds (exit 2), never a mergeable state. The floor SEMANTICS (which legs, why) live in the gateway + records/specs; shape is normative here.
